_doc: Live Now i18n strings — ChatGPT SELL lane, 2026-10-13.
_structure: Flat object: {'en': {...}, 'hi': {...}, 'es': {...}, 'pt': {...}}. Keys are stable — Gemini build lane consumes them directly. Chrome keys: panel.*, card.*, time.*, confidence.*, severity.*. Card template keys: card.<type>.title1..3 / summary1..3. {placeholders} are substituted at RENDER time (client-side), never ingest time, so language can switch on the card. Placeholder values are data (proper nouns, numbers) and stay identical across languages. Variant rule: 1 = verified default, 2 = verified/reported alternate, 3 = unconfirmed ONLY (cautious wording, never enters the auto-tour). Titles <=90 chars, summaries <=200 chars after substitution — truncate with '…' if overflow. No private-person data anywhere. Aviation/maritime severity-5 templates must NEVER speculate on casualties.
